verdict.rationale: Obsidian's official developer docs cover building plugins in TypeScript, and include a tutorial that compiles a sample plugin from source and loads it into Obsidian. The obsidian-api GitHub repo documents interfaces such as Vault, and a community user reports building a metadata-to-CloudWatch integration with the plugin API. Missing for 10: deeper evidence of the API reference's breadth beyond the Vault interface snippet.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build my own plugins against a documented extension API/SDK with samples and developer docs
